# What is written plain here and is not YAML is put in quotes, and nothing else is.
blueprint: parted
description: A board: its cards, and what moves them
params:
  note: { type: string, default: said: so }
steps:
  say:
    do: emit
    when: ${ params.n > 1 ? true : false }
    with:
      topic: shop.said
      data:
        why: he said "no: never"
        both: it's "so: so"
        mark: ${ params.note + ' #1' }
        plain: nothing to see  # a comment stays one
        ends: so it ends:
        more: > than one
        left: "in quotes: as it was"
        whole: ${params.note}
        count: 3
